doc: world/lease-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: lease lifecycle state machine, rent-run calendar, notice ladder, deposit/deduction rules, dispute schema, progression gates, and feed wording. Registry numbers (rents, tenants, units) live in jobs-housing.md §3 — this file governs how leases MOVE. All money is game dollars except credit-denominated fees marked cr (monetization §2.4/§2.8 PROPOSAL — do not contradict).

power_map.requests_pipeline: admin-domain deny — lease/rent/eviction asks are unreachable by request (moderation.json v8)
power_map.currency_wall: credits never pay rent/deposits/fees — game dollars only

states.note: unit on the board (housing.json listings_live + ladder)
application in; screening conditions evaluated (income ~2.5x, references, roommate interview)
lease offered; signing is atomic: lease row + first month + deposit + move-in record + listing off board + feed event
unpaid at day 10; formal notice issued
balance cleared at any rung; back to active, arrears history retained as a file scar
board filing open; notice ladder AND any posted raise FROZEN at current rung
admin queue card — never automatic; ledger + notices + disputes + household facts on the card
tenancy ended by admin; feed 'admin' event, neutral wording
tenant notice (30d), lease-end, OR no-fault notice (60d, mandatory relocation credit); deposit return itemized
unit between tenants; flips back to listed
deed recorded; rent line replaced by tax/HOA

lease_terms.then: month-to-month — no renewal paperwork, no rent bump for staying
lease_terms.rule: term stated on every lease file; ending a fixed term early is the tenant's break-fee conversation, month-to-month ends on 30-day notice
lease_terms.break_fee: notice inside the fixed term posts an itemized break fee — one month's rent, a ledger line deducted at deposit return; month-to-month ends on plain 30-day notice
lease_terms.demo_field: term — one line per lease row; breakFee flag + depPending/depDue on the lease

late_fee.note: house rule stated in every lease

rent_run.frozen_while: disputed (any rung) — no eviction while a board ruling is open

rent_control.raise_rule: every raise posts with a stated basis; the claim is what a dispute examines

annual_band.note: house rule, unbanked — use it or lose it; ledger line + dated notice

passthrough_claim.note: itemized math required in ledger; the claim is what a dispute examines

rent_control.raise_storage: posted raise stores rent_next; the 1st bills the new number; a filed dispute before the 1st sets rent_frozen — old rent bills until ruling/mediation withdraws or amends it

payment_plans.binding: nothing pauses until accepted — a proposal is an offer, not a shield
payment_plans.effect: honored plan pauses late-fee accrual and holds the ladder at plan_rung; balance still owes
payment_plans.installments: dated ledger lines; each due-day is checked — paid flag or breach
payment_plans.breach: missed installment resumes the ladder at plan_rung (never reset to day 6); breach is itself a ledger line
payment_plans.visibility: private mail — never a feed event
payment_plans.doc: the plan is a ledger document: proposed, dated, itemized installments

published_conditions: income ~2.5x rent (verified vs job board wages)
roommate interview where the unit shares a wall
screening.rule: first qualified application approves — no auctions, no vibe denials, no holding a listing to shop applicants
screening.decline_visibility: private mail naming the failed criterion; no feed event
sign_atomic: first month + deposit leave the bank
screening.proration: signing after the 1st prorates the first month — round(rent × days-remaining / 30); the deposit stays 1× rent; the prorated line is itemized on the ledger

guarantor.near_miss_band: income 2.0x–2.5x rent — clears the floor, misses the published multiple; the file offers a guarantor path instead of a flat decline
guarantor.under_floor: below 2.0x declines — private mail naming the criterion; no feed event
guarantor.attach: tenant names a guarantor; verified on the same published checklist (income, references); co-signs the lease doc before signing
guarantor.liability: rent + deposit; never a tenant, never an occupant line, never a feed event
guarantor.demo_fields: guar (near-miss flag), guarantor (name once attached); screening can't finish while guar is set and unattached
guarantor.release: after 12 on-time months the tenant may request a guarantor release — the landlord file / admin decides; the release is a file doc (guarRelReq → decided), never a feed event; a declined release names the missing months and can be re-requested

move_in_record.contents: itemized condition lines; anything marked pre-existing is the baseline
move_in_record.gate: a deposit deduction naming a pre-existing item is refused outright — the record settles it, not an argument
move_in_record.demo_field: movein — array of condition lines per lease

notices.name: formal_notice
notices.service: posted to door + mailed, both dated — the window runs from service, not the posting

notices.name: cure_or_quit
notices.service: posted to door + mailed, both dated — cure by service day + 14

notices.name: eviction_filing
notices.trigger: window expired, no cure, no open dispute
notices.service: posted to door + mailed, both dated

notices.name: no_fault_notice
notices.note: admin-only; mandatory relocation credit; distinct NOFAULT ledger code

deposits.interest: simple ~1%/yr texture line — registry tracks principal, ledger computes at return
deposits.return_clock: move-out starts the clock — depPending + depDue (move-out day + 21); the return posts as a separate itemized event by admin or the unit's licensed landlord; an overdue return writes a 'deposit return overdue' ledger line (board-able grounds) and the lateness stays on the file
deduction_whitelist: damage beyond ordinary wear (named per item)
cleaning to move-in condition (only if returned worse)
deposits.move_in_gate: deductions are checked against the move-in record; a pre-existing item is refused, not argued
deposits.return_rule: minus itemized deductions only — every deduction is a ledger line with a reason
deposits.informal_occupants: room shares (c2-jules, c3-dani) are person-to-person — never ledger objects
deposits.walkthrough: move-out writes an itemized walkthrough doc — each finding measured against the move-in record; every deduction must cite a walkthrough line, and pre-existing items stay refused outright
deposits.demo_field_walk: walkthrough — array of finding lines, written on all three exits (tenant notice, recorded move-out, no-fault)

receipts.rule: any payment line can issue a dated receipt doc on request — itemized, same numbers as the ledger
receipts.weight: dispute evidence — the ledger and the receipt say the same thing; a receipt that disagrees with the ledger is itself a finding
receipts.visibility: tenant file only — never a feed event

entry_notices.rule: entry needs a stated reason, a stated window, and >=24h of notice — every entry notice is a dated doc on the file
entry_notices.visibility: tenant file only — never a feed event
entry_notices.violation: repeated or unnotified entry is a dispute ground (entry_violation); the entry log is the evidence
entry_notices.demo_field: entry — array of {svc, day, win, reason} per lease

sale_occupied.rule: the paper follows the deed — a sale with a sitting tenant carries the lease, deposit, move-in record, and file to the new owner of record, same terms, same protections, same rent-control flag
sale_occupied.tenant_doc: a dated 'sale — tenant in place' doc lands on the tenant's file the day the deed transfers
sale_occupied.never: a sale never resets a tenancy, a deposit, a term, or a file scar

renewal.offer: landlord file / licensed landlord posts a renewal offer — new fixed 12-mo term at a stated rent; a number above current rent is a stated-basis posting subject to the same raise rules
renewal.decide: the tenant decides — accept runs a new fixed term from signing (same file, same deposit, same move-in record); decline or lapse rolls the lease to month-to-month at term end
renewal.binding: an offer is not a raise — nothing bills until it is signed
renewal.visibility: file docs only — never a feed event
renewal.term_flip: serving month 12 flips the lease to month-to-month on its own — staying is the default, no paperwork, no bump for staying
renewal.demo_fields: termMo (month of fixed term), renewal {rent, day, decided}

returned_payments.rule: a returned payment reverses onto the balance and posts a returned-payment fee — house rule, capped $25, stated in the lease
returned_payments.ladder: the ladder stands where it stood — a returned payment is not a new default and never resets or accelerates the notice ladder
returned_payments.visibility: file only — never a feed event
returned_payments.demo: markReturned reverses the last payment line and adds the capped fee

habitability.sla: acknowledged same-day, scheduled ~2 days, target fix <= 7 days
habitability.breach: open past the target writes an SLA-breach ledger line — legal weight that strengthens a dispute; the breach stays on the file after the fix

routine.sla: acknowledged ~3 days, scheduled ~7, done ~14; every status change is a dated ledger object

repairs.dispute_weight: open habitability item strengthens a dispute; rulings may order repair + rent credit

amendments.roommate_swap: co-tenant add/remove is a lease-amendment doc + deposit pro-rata ledger line; the incoming name is screened like any applicant; the remaining tenant's file keeps continuity; joint liability, one balance — the ledger doesn't adjudicate splits
amendments.decline: a declined amendment names the reason on the file; a new amendment can be filed

disputes.raise_freeze: a filing with rent_next pending sets rent_frozen — old rent bills on the 1st until ruling or a signed offer

mediation.offer: either side states a concrete ledger-shaped proposal during mediation_week; documented on the file
mediation.accept: amends the ledger directly (new rent line, repair scheduled, filing withdrawn → active); posts the same neutral 'rent-board ruling' feed line — a deal reads like a decision
mediation.decline: costs the week it took; ruling clock resumes; either side can walk
mediation.never: dialogue scripts — offers are proposals, not performed conversations

disputes.evidence: ledger objects only — repair requests, payment lines, claimed passthrough math, the move-in record; no testimony mechanics
disputes.feed: rulings are housing events, neutral wording; amounts stay in the file
disputes.live_example: bld-g9457-3 (c4-priya+c5-marcus): raise 2600->3200 contested on passthrough claim + dead heater; keep ambiguous, never resolve in content

sublets.request: tenant files: named subtenant, stated dates, rent at or under lease rate
sublets.rule: approval not unreasonably withheld — a decline needs a stated reason on the file
sublets.board: a live sublet posts a listing-shaped entry marked (sublet); tenant of record stays liable
sublets.informal: informal room shares stay person-to-person and off-ledger — unchanged

eviction.hired_characters: not exempt — miss rent and the admin may evict (design §6)
eviction.feed_wording: admin action — tenancy ended at <address>; never the debt amount, never the reason text

assignments.vs_sublet: sublet is temporary and the tenant stays liable; assignment is the permanent hand-off — the lease changes names
assignments.request: tenant files a named assignee — screened on the same published checklist (income, references); approval not unreasonably withheld — a decline needs a stated reason on the file
assignments.clean_ledger_gate: the ledger must be clean to hand over — a balance blocks assignment (settle, or finish a plan first)
assignments.effect: assignee becomes tenant of record — same terms, same rent-control flag, same file; the deposit carries to the new name (no second deposit, no reset); outgoing tenant's liability ends at signing; file scars stay with the unit's file, not the departing name
assignments.record: the landlord file decides — licensed landlords decide requests on their own units only, same cap as every other tool
assignments.visibility: file-only — never a feed event; tenant names never reach the wire

buyouts.rule: cash-for-keys is an offer, not an instruction — a stated amount on the file, and the tenant decides
buyouts.offerable_when: active only — never under a live rung (arrears/noticed), never while a dispute is open; a buyout is not a shortcut around the ladder
buyouts.cooldown: a declined offer locks re-offer for 30 days (buyoutCool); declining costs nothing — no fee, no mark, no retaliation leg
buyouts.accept: ordinary move-out paper plus a BUYOUT credit line (distinct ledger code, same legibility rule as NOFAULT); deposit still returns separately, itemized, on the 21-day clock
buyouts.amount: stated figure on the file (demo: two months' rent) — game dollars, itemized
buyouts.visibility: offer, amount, and decline are file-only; an accepted buyout posts at most the neutral turnover feed line

prepaid_rent.rule: voluntary prepay posts a 'prepaid rent credit' line; the file tracks prepaid as a running credit
prepaid_rent.cap: three months' rent on the file — a bridge, never a deposit substitute or a favor economy
prepaid_rent.drawdown: the 1st draws down: rent charge posts, then 'prepaid credit applied' covers it oldest-first before any balance exists — a prepaid month never sees a day-6 fee

history_letter.rule: any tenant may request a rental history letter — a dated file doc summarizing the tenancy in neutral ledger terms: term dates, months paid, scars stated as scars, deposit disposition
history_letter.once: one letter per tenancy — writes once
history_letter.portable: the same numbers the ledger keeps, formatted to hand to the next screening; editorializes nothing
history_letter.visibility: file doc, never a feed event

file_scars.rule: cured arrears stay on the file (hist) — visible to the tenant and to landlords of that unit; never a feed event, never a denial criterion on its own

owner.rule: offer at asking, first accepted wins — no bidding

feed_wording.listing_filled: Listing filled — <address> comes off the board
feed_wording.turnover: Unit turning over — <address> back on the board

utilities.rule: every lease states who pays which service — a lease term, not a footnote; demo field utils lists tenant-paid services per unit
utilities.billing: tenant-paid utilities post as their own itemized ledger line each 1st ('utilities — <services>'), itemized by service; they bill beside rent, never inside it — a posted rent stays the posted rent
utilities.unpaid: an unpaid utility line is a balance like any other and climbs the same ladder — but it is never folded into the rent number; the ledger itemizes, the feed sees nothing
utilities.dispute_ground: a bill for a service the lease makes landlord-paid is a contested_charge ground — the lease term is the evidence
utilities.visibility: file + ledger only — never a feed event

rent_board_fee.rule: the annual Rent Board fee is a per-unit cost on the owner's file (game-systems assessor: $59/unit on installment 1); the landlord may pass up to half to the tenant as an itemized annual line — never folded into rent, never stacked with a raise posting
rent_board_fee.pass_through_cap: 50% of the fee, rounded down to the dollar — the tenant's half is a stated line, not a rent bump
rent_board_fee.ledger_code: RBF — distinct code, same legibility rule as NOFAULT/BUYOUT; the pass-through must name the year and the split
rent_board_fee.cadence: once per year per unit; a second posting inside 12 months is refused outright — the file keeps the dates
rent_board_fee.visibility: file + ledger only — never a feed event
rent_board_fee.demo: postRBF posts 'Rent Board fee — 50% pass-through (RBF)' on a tenant-paid line

abandoned_property.rule: belongings left at move-out are paper, not trash — move-out writes an itemized abandoned-property notice when the walkthrough finds items
abandoned_property.claim: the departed tenant claims inside the window — a dated file doc ends it (items released, no deduction)
abandoned_property.after_window: unclaimed past the window posts a disposal doc; reasonable storage cost is a stated deduction line at deposit return, cited to the notice
never: a feed event — the block never sees someone's things
abandoned_property.demo_fields: abandoned {day, claimBy, resolved} — written by the walkthrough when it finds items

change_of_terms.rule: a landlord may change house terms (storage, bike room, laundry hours) on paper — a dated change-of-terms doc with a stated effective date at least 30 days out
change_of_terms.gate: month-to-month only — a fixed term can't be rewritten mid-lease; the doc is refused inside a fixed term
change_of_terms.scope: house terms only — never rent (that's the raise path), never the deposit, never the protections on the file; a rent change wearing a change-of-terms doc is refused outright
change_of_terms.respond: the tenant may respond on the file; a contested change can go to the board like anything else
change_of_terms.visibility: file doc, never a feed event

last_month_proration.rule: a move-out that lands mid-month prorates the last month — symmetric to the first-month rule (§29): round(rent × days-occupied / 30), itemized 'last month — prorated to day N'
last_month_proration.notice_math: the 30-day notice already names the end day; the proration is computed at the recorded move-out, never rounded up
last_month_proration.deposit: untouched — the deposit clock and the itemized return run exactly as before

demo_seed.note: lease.html demo state — mirrors jobs-housing §3; money in game $
demo_seed.viewer_character: h01 (demo hired character, tenant of bld-g9457-2, income $4,600/mo game-$)
demo_seed.licensed_landlord: h02 (demo; owns bld-f9088-5, studio rented to an ambient tenant, balance outstanding day 1)
demo_seed.day: day 6 of the month — h01's rent is in grace-lapsed; 9457-3 dispute is open with its raise frozen
demo_seed.v54_surfaces: prorated first month on mid-month signing; break fee inside a fixed term; repair clock (habitability ≤7-day SLA + breach line); roommate amendments; 21-day deposit clock with overdue line
demo_seed.v68_surfaces: guarantor path on near-miss screening (9418-B at $2,100 is a near-miss on $4,600; 9127-A at $1,300 passes clean); service records on notices 2–4 (clock runs from service); move-out walkthrough doc; rent receipts
demo_seed.v82_surfaces: notices of entry (≥24h, stated reason + window, file-only); sale with a tenant in place (paper follows the deed — admin records it on an occupied unit, e.g. 9263-4); renewal offers inside months 10–12 of a fixed term (h01 at month 10, 9088-5 at month 11); returned payments (reversal + capped $25 fee, ladder unchanged); guarantor release after 12 on-time months
demo_seed.v96_surfaces: lease assignment (clean-ledger hand-off, deposit carries, file-only); buyout offers (active-only, 30-day re-offer cooldown, BUYOUT credit code); prepaid rent credit (3-month cap, draws down on the 1st before any balance); the rental history letter (one dated abstract per tenancy, file-only)
demo_seed.v110_surfaces: tenant-paid utilities billed as their own itemized ledger line (utils per lease, beside rent never inside it); the Rent Board fee pass-through ($59/unit fee on the owner's file, up to half passed as an itemized RBF line, once a year, never folded into rent); abandoned property at move-out (itemized notice, 15-day claim window, disposal doc + cited storage deduction); change-of-terms docs (month-to-month only, ≥30 days out, house terms never rent); last-month proration on a mid-month move-out
